_about: twoway fpfit and fpfitci on edge cases, StataNow 19.5, 23sep2026 (the WP-18 review): the data each probe used, and the plotted serset of each saved .gph read back with serset use (float32; rows with a missing fit dropped, a missing band kept as null). tc: hourly %tc over 3 days; tc2: 5-minute %tc over a day; d30/d90/daily: %td; bin0/binx: x with two values; n2/n3: auto in 1/2, 1/3; fw3: collapsed data with fweights; yc: constant y; awneg: a negative aweight; fwn: non-integer fweights; xoff: x offset by 1e6. Empty stata fp/ci means twoway drew nothing.
